comparison.color_space: sRGB RGB; no resizing or registration after source measurement

metric_method_notes.sphere: Fitted source circle versus independently rendered measured circle; fit residuals and inlier count are included in sphere geometry JSON.
metric_method_notes.fish: Source warm-pixel segmentation inside fixed source-registered ROIs versus independent V2 alpha assets resized to source-registered silhouette boxes; source threshold can omit cool translucent fins, so IoU confidence is MEDIUM.
metric_method_notes.resident: Per-ID hue/saturation mask within source-registered path corridors. Chamfer compares source-supported visible trace segments to the rendered centerline; gaps are interpolated in the static composition from adjacent samples and a low-confidence curve prior, with their fraction listed per resident. Same-hue crossings remain ambiguous.
metric_method_notes.plants: Source HSV mask within full-resolution registered foliage bounds; cyan-green transparent leaf edges are excluded; MEDIUM_LOW.
metric_method_notes.rocks: Source blue-green texture mask within measured object envelopes; contact shadows/moss edges are ambiguous; MEDIUM_LOW.

limitations: Static CPU reconstruction only; no GPU or motion fidelity is claimed.
Resident identities at same-color overlaps remain partly ambiguous.
Composite asset set does not reproduce all source-specific caustic microstructure, refraction, volumetric haze and fine glow.
